description: A true polyglot formatter and linter for 36 languages: one binary and one config file in place of Prettier, ESLint, ruff and more
headline: Ready for 32 languages, early support for 4 more.
ready: Ready: HTML, JavaScript / TypeScript, CSS / SCSS / Less, JSON / JSONC, Markdown, Python, YAML, Shell, Dockerfile, SQL, Jupyter Notebook, Java, Batchfile, GitHub Actions, C#, PowerShell, Makefile, Kubernetes manifests, TOML, XML, Go, CMake, Kotlin, Vue / Svelte, Terraform (HCL), Angular templates, INI / EditorConfig / .gitignore, Ansible, Ruby, Procfile, GraphQL and Protobuf. The rest are in progress.
